name.english: 8% income tax option for purely self-employed individuals and professionals
name.filipino: 8% income tax option para sa purely self-employed at mga propesyonal
name.taglish: 8% income tax option para sa purely self-employed at professionals

applies_to: Purely self-employed individuals and/or professionals (no compensation income) whose gross sales/receipts and other non-operating income do not exceed the VAT threshold, and who elected the 8% option for the year.

kb_references.title: BIR_Income_Tax_FAQ
kb_references.what: 8% option, purely self-employed: gross sales/receipts + non-operating income = gross taxable income; less P250,000 (Sec. 24(A)(2)(b)) = net taxable income; x 8% = income tax due; less tax withheld (BIR Form 2307) = income tax payable (Question 10, Part B(i)).

label.english: 8% option under the TRAIN Law (tax years 2018 onwards)
label.filipino: 8% option sa ilalim ng TRAIN Law (taong 2018 pataas)
label.taglish: 8% option under TRAIN Law (tax years 2018 onwards)

versions.legal_basis: Sec. 24(A)(2)(b), NIRC of 1997 as amended by RA No. 10963 (TRAIN Law); VAT threshold of P3,000,000 under Sec. 109(BB) as amended by RA No. 10963

sources.title: Republic Act No. 10963 (TRAIN Law), Sec. 24(A)(2)(b) and Sec. 109(BB) NIRC as amended
Senate Tax Study and Research Office, Primer on the TRAIN Law (March 2018)

verification.notes: Rate, P250,000 deduction and computation steps also appear in the knowledge base (BIR_Income_Tax_FAQ, Question 10 Part B(i)). The P3,000,000 eligibility ceiling is the VAT threshold in Sec. 109(BB) as amended by RA 10963; it is not stated in the knowledge-base PDFs.
